bibliographic.title: Cubes and Ladders
bibliographic.author: P.Rail
bibliographic.description:
Unravel Mysteries and Navigate Dangers in Minimax: A Puzzle Adventure

If you're ready to take a step back, zoom out, re-baseline your North Star, re-evaluate your swim lane, and ultimately re-commit to over-delivering on a go-forward basis, Cubes and Ladders is the adventure game for you.

As the CEO of Minimax Inc. is fond of reminding us, “Success is a journey, so buckle up and stop asking where we’re going.”

In this Dilbert-esque parser comedy, you play a new intern navigating broken systems, apathetic coworkers, and clueless management. Can you turn things around in a business committed to making clarity obsolete? To succeed, you’ll align metrics with stakeholder expectations, unpack the data, drill down, deep dive, bubble things up, cascade them down, and leverage synergistic paradigms.

Net-net, your plate is full. You’ll move the needle, grab the low-hanging fruit, and push the envelope in pursuit of next-generation, future-proof, mission-critical outcomes. Just remember: at Minimax, it’s not a layoff. It’s a strategic realignment of headcount to zero.

Your keyboard awaits. Your coffee is cold. This is Cubes and Ladders.

I've included a walkthrough with the game solution. You should refer to it as a last resort if you get stuck.
